source.section: Consolidated Results · Reconciliation of Net Income to Adjusted Operating Earnings
source.quote: First quarter 2026 after-tax adjusted operating earnings of $214 million, or $2.26 per diluted share, up 13% from the prior year.

source.quote: the company returned $150 million and $44 million of excess capital to shareholders through share repurchases and common stock dividends, respectively.
